plaatsen.tekst: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may ➔ by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
